eyebrow: Compilation is lazy — the first call pays the cost
code:
model = torch.compile(model)

outputs = model(inputs)   # first call: slow (compiling)
# every call after: fast (cached compiled kernels)
caption: A new input shape can trigger recompilation and pay that cost again

eyebrow: Modes trade compile time for runtime speed
code:
torch.compile(model, mode="reduce-overhead")  # + CUDA graphs
torch.compile(model, mode="max-autotune")      # searches more kernels
caption: Frequent graph breaks — eager-mode fallbacks mid-trace — cap the speedup either way
